decision: D52 rung (4): A5, the five checker rules

lines.R1: last-error-read: every read of cCatchError is a note, worded in its handler or outside one
lines.R2: text-run-as-code: eval of non-literal text is an error unless a named validator is called in the same body
lines.R3: listener-binds-all: a literal 0.0.0.0, :: or "" given to a named listener is a warning; told of none, it says so
lines.R4: global-restored-by-hand: a $global saved in a local and written back from it outside a finally is a warning
lines.R5: handle-held-across-raise: a local engine handle no finally releases, and the body does not return, is a warning

cases.why: a read of cCatchError in its handler is a note
cases.stdout:

  6:5  note   haro/last-error-read
          cCatchError read in its handler -- bind the error instead (`catch e`) and read e

  0 error, 0 warn, 0 perf, 1 note   in 1 file(s)
  listener-binds-all: no listening native named (--listeners=), so no call was looked at
